meta.name: trojan_horse_troy
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

programs.brief: A colossal hollow wooden horse built from dark weathered ship timbers and oak planks (api.theme.wood), resting on heavy wheeled skids. The interior is a hollow braced chamber with ladder rungs and a concealed belly trapdoor where Greek soldiers wait in silence.
A scattered cluster of abandoned Greek camp equipment on the sand: charred timber posts, bronze shields, amphorae jars, and collapsed tent poles.

tokens.terrain: a fortified city on a high hill overlooking the Aegean coastal plain and sea
tokens.icons: a massive wooden horse standing in the central plaza before the royal citadel; towering stone circuit walls with the Scaean gate; deserted Greek encampment on the distant beach
tokens.infra: monumental stone ramp up to the main gatehouse; wide stone-paved processional way from the gate to the megaron palace; dry stone retaining walls along the upper citadel
tokens.event_detail: Grecian soldiers concealed inside the hollow wooden horse awaiting nightfall to open the gates
